name: Pro Shaper Sheet Metal LLC
old_description: Our shop handles TIG, MIG, and specialty welding for steel, stainless, aluminum, and more. From repair work to fully custom fabrication, we take on projects that require precision, strength, and practical problem solving.
about:
Pro Shaper Sheet Metal LLC operates from Charlton, Massachusetts. The business traces its lineage to a restoration shop started in the 1960s by Ted Billings in Worcester, where his grandson Wray grew up learning metalworking on classic Auburns and Chris-Craft boats. Wray now leads the company, which evolved from that family tradition into a dedicated metal-shaping resource.

The shop provides TIG, MIG, and specialty welding on steel, stainless steel, and aluminum, along with full custom fabrication and coachbuilding services. It also runs hands-on classes covering wheeling, planishing, shrinking, stretching, and panel development. In addition, Pro Shaper designs and sells professional-grade shaping tools — including shrinking discs, mallet sets with Delrin heads, lead-shot dollies, and shaping kits — curated for serious fabricators.

Customers range from classic-car restorers and Auburn/Cord/Duesenberg club members to fabricators developing one-off concepts and hobbyists building their skills. The company’s coachbuilding work emphasizes period correctness with modern durability, while its classes and tools serve both professional shops and individual builders.

Pro Shaper positions itself as a bridge between old-world coachbuilding discipline and today’s fabrication demands. The team builds and sources tools that “earn their place on the bench” and teaches users to maximize each pass, guided by the principle that “control, patience, and the right tool — that is how great shapes happen.”
